subject: Television & Streaming
title: How the News Cycle Shapes Reality
description: A quick, practical guide to How the News Cycle Shapes Reality.

hook.text: CNN launched in 1980 as the first 24-hour news channel. News was no longer something you watched—it was always on.

buildup.text: The 24-hour cycle needed constant content. Stories were stretched, repeated, and analyzed until the next crisis arrived.

discovery.text: The format rewarded urgency over accuracy. Breaking news became the default mode even when nothing was breaking.

twist.text: Fox News and MSNBC proved that partisan framing attracts loyal audiences.

climax.text: 24-hour news didn't just report reality—it shaped it. What the news covers becomes what the public cares about.

quiz.question: What effect did 24-hour news have on journalism?
options: It rewarded urgency and opinion over objectivity
It reduced the number of news stories
